name: Mahou Shoujo Subaru
source:
The evil stone conceives a part of the king of the hell's power in a different world. To prevent his revival, the stone is implanted into a body of a magical girl!
Now the clans from the hell follow after her. The evil stone cannot be regained by a simple destruction of the body. Thus, they start disgracing the magical girls in various ways!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE056413.html]DLsite English[/url]]
